sloka: इति इव तत् वाक्यम् अदुष्ट भावासुदुष्टम् उक्त्वा रजनी चरम् तम् ।गात्र प्रकंपात् व्यथिता बभूववात उद्धता सा कदली इव तन्वी ॥३-४७-४९॥
transliteration: iti iva tat vākyam aduṣṭa bhāvāsuduṣṭam uktvā rajanī caram tam ।gātra prakaṁpāt vyathitā babhūvavāta uddhatā sā kadalī iva tanvī ॥3-47-49॥

translations.english: Having said thus to the wicked nightwalker Ravana, Sita, pure in thought remained distressed.Her slender body started trembling like a banana plant becomes shaken by a violent wind.
